name: Sidhant Sridhar
tagline: Industrial design engineer, from concept to construction.
about: A designer who wants to make a change in the design industry, with the aim of adding some much-needed flavour to the design space.

From disassembling broken toys as a kid to 3D printing wonders in my living room, I have always been a self-starter. My passion ignited in 6th-grade robotics club, surrounded by the first generation of Arduinos and 3D printers in India. High school clarified my joy: designing and building. Fast forward to three years in the Netherlands, and I became a workshop wizard, with a knack for rapid prototyping, metalwork, CAD, surface modelling, 3D printing and manufacturing drawings, the works.

Post-graduation, my hunger for creation intensified. My living room now houses a 3D printer, and our dining table is a bustling workbench of open electronics and wires. Microcontrollers, ESP boards and custom-designed projects have become my new frontier.
Based in the Netherlands, and on the lookout for opportunities to collaborate and create.
